description: This Java class represents the response to a 'ModifyFeatureProperties' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates information such as the ID of the Thing and Feature involved, the created FeatureProperties (if any), HTTP status codes, and parsing logic for JSON representations of the response.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response to a modify feature properties command, including status, headers, and created feature properties.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating feature properties were created, with deprecated overload accepting string IDs.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating feature properties were modified, with deprecated overload accepting string IDs.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to parse a JSON string or object into a response instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose properties were affected.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertiesCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created FeatureProperties, if any.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Provides the entity data (FeatureProperties) related to the response, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into JSON format.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare response instances.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response.
